sections.title: Charge audit
sections.sql: select v.* from v_bill_audit v join charges c on c.id=v.id where c.invoice_id=$1

sections.title: Allocations
sections.sql: select v.* from v_allocations v join charges c on c.id=v.id where c.invoice_id=$1

name: dispute-letter
title: Draft carrier dispute letter
for_each: select id,code from disputes where status in ('open','submitted','accepted')

sections.title: Reason and evidence
sections.sql: select reason,evidence,follow_up_on from disputes where id=$1

sections.title: Credits received
sections.sql: select code,amount_cents,received_on,evidence from credits where dispute_id=$1

name: renewal-brief
title: Carrier renewal decision brief
for_each: select id,code from services where status='active'

sections.title: Recent billed charges
sections.sql: select c.code,c.name,c.amount_cents,i.code as invoice,i.period_start,i.period_end from charges c join invoices i on i.id=c.invoice_id where c.service_id=$1 order by i.period_end desc
